paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将10.3g叔丁醇钠(98％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待叔丁醇钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为98.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Add 200mL of tert-butanol to the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip in 10.3g of sodium tert-butoxide (98％, 0.105mol). Once the sodium tert-butoxide is uniformly dispersed, control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and pour 34.8g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1mol) into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction is slightly exothermic; control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and react for 6h. At the end of the reaction, in-process liquid chromatography gives a normalised content of sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 98.3％. The solvent is stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material is used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: The vessel is called a 反应瓶 (reaction flask) at the start and a 釜 (kettle/reactor) later in the same paragraph; translated literally. Whether 碱解 here means ester hydrolysis to the carboxylate salt is not stated beyond the product name.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The Chinese name places 甲基 (methyl) after the parenthesised trifluoroethoxy group, i.e. the substituent is a (2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl group at C3. Translated literally.
This marker labels a reaction scheme drawing only; it carries no prose. See drawings[1].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入130mL THF、10.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.105mol)和11.8g叔丁醇钠(98％，0.12mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在10℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.8g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.8％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.7％。
paragraphs.en: Add 130mL of THF, 10.6g of trifluoroethanol (99％, 0.105mol) and 11.8g of sodium tert-butoxide (98％, 0.12mol) to the reactor, start stirring, control the kettle temperature at 10℃, and add the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.3％, 0.1mol) into the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3h; after addition is complete, hold the temperature and react for 4h. When the reaction is complete, strip the solvent under reduced pressure, add 120mL of water to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2. Then filter, rinse with water and dry to obtain 32.8g of product; HPLC quantification gives a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 97.8％, and a two-step reaction yield of 92.7％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: 三氟乙醇 is written without a position prefix; from the drawing it is CF3CH2OH (2,2,2-trifluoroethanol). The paragraph says 反应釜 (reactor) for the charge and 反应瓶 (reaction flask) for the portionwise addition; translated literally.

paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: 苯甲酸盐 names an unspecified benzoate salt; the drawing that follows specifies the potassium salt.

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将12.4g叔丁醇钾(95％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待叔丁醇钾分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.0％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Add 200mL of tert-butanol to the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip in 12.4g of potassium tert-butoxide (95％, 0.105mol). Once the potassium tert-butoxide is uniformly dispersed, control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and pour 34.8g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1mol) into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction is slightly exothermic; control the kettle temperature at 25℃ and react for 6h. At the end of the reaction, in-process liquid chromatography gives a normalised content of potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 98.0％. The solvent is stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material is used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The scheme this sentence introduces is not on this page; it continues onto the next page.

drawings.notes: The four ring substituents are drawn on four consecutive ring carbons: the ester on the left vertex, Cl on the next vertex clockwise (top), CH2Br on the next (top right), and SO2CH3 on the next (right). Sodium is drawn as NaO-C(=O)-, i.e. written covalently; recorded as the carboxylate salt in SMILES. This scheme belongs to step (1) of the example that began on the previous page (the example number is not printed on this page).

Above the arrow the two reagents are separated by the full-width enumeration comma: CF3CH2OH、C4H9ONa. HCl is written below the arrow and is the acidification step described in [0115]. The product's C3 chain is drawn as ring-CH2-O-CH2-CF3, with the CF3 label at the far right.
Step (1) of Example 8. Potassium is drawn as KO-C(=O)-, written covalently; recorded as the carboxylate salt in SMILES. C4H9OK is the only label on the arrow and sits above it.

discrepancies.what: The base drawn over the first arrow is not the base the accompanying procedure uses.
discrepancies.drawing_says: NaOH above the arrow in the [0111] scheme.
discrepancies.text_says: [0112] charges 200mL tert-butanol and 10.3g sodium tert-butoxide (叔丁醇钠, 98％, 0.105mol); NaOH is never mentioned in the procedure.

discrepancies.what: The solvent used in the etherification is written in the prose but not drawn on the scheme.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The [0114] arrow carries only CF3CH2OH、C4H9ONa above and HCl below; no solvent.

discrepancies.what: The stoichiometry of the base in the etherification is given only in the prose.
discrepancies.drawing_says: C4H9ONa above the arrow with no amount.
discrepancies.text_says: [0115] gives 11.8g sodium tert-butoxide (98％, 0.12mol) against 0.1mol substrate, i.e. an excess.

discrepancies.what: The step title names an unspecified salt while the scheme specifies the cation.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The [0118] scheme draws the potassium carboxylate (KO-C(=O)-) and C4H9OK as reagent.
discrepancies.text_says: [0117] is titled 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐 (the benzoate salt), with no cation; [0119] then specifies potassium tert-butoxide and the potassium salt.
